sourceRecordAuthority: exact digest supplied by the source-immutable proof host; a caller-selected replacement record is not an authority
ciProof: existing Ubuntu nextest shards and macOS process nextest; actual Node must be 22.23.2; stdout carries observed OS/arch/kernel/Node digest

enforcement.processes: two supervisor-owned sibling PIDs; Seatbelt denies process-fork on Darwin; Linux seccomp permits clone only for same-process threads, refuses fork/vfork and clone3, and denies signalling foreign PIDs; a one-use pipe-backed spawn hook connects the peers
enforcement.filesystem: Seatbelt or Landlock ABI >=3 denies file reads outside staged roots, explicit fake settings and runtime paths; source writes, new files/directories and hard links are refused. Linux seccomp also denies metadata-changing syscalls; Landlock does not mediate stat
enforcement.network: Darwin permits TCP at the declared loopback port (IPv4 or IPv6). Linux denies new sockets/connect/bind and io_uring, while the native receives one supervisor-connected socket to the owned IPv4 listener
enforcement.storage: Seatbelt's finite writable-path set plus hard RLIMIT_FSIZE; no sampled directory-size claim
enforcement.output: supervisor accounts native stdout, native stderr, driver stdout and driver stderr during reads before relaying
enforcement.deadlineAndCancel: monotonic supervisor deadline or owned output barrier; kill only owned PIDs, then wait for both actual exit results

missingOriginalCapabilities: settled same-user interpreter and source custody, including Node libraries and OS startup policy
